verdict.rationale: An agent framework with a Studio and observability product could plausibly offer built-in AI-generated insights over a user's data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no such feature. Studio, tracing, scoring and dataset capture are inspection and evaluation tools, not AI-generated insights or suggestions. Agents and tools a developer could use to build an insights feature are building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
